subject: Board deck for Sept 22 - can I see the numbers by Thursday?
body: Sam, before the board meeting on the 22nd I want to walk through the numbers with you one on one. Send me the ARR bridge, net retention and the hiring plan by Thursday EOD so I have time to read them properly. If the Series A conversation is going to come up at the board, I would rather we align first.

subject: Re: Multi-year renewal - pricing
body: Our procurement team will sign a three-year deal, but they want 20% off the current rate and payment annually in arrears instead of upfront. I have room to push back on the payment terms, not on the discount. Our renewal date is Oct 31, and legal needs three weeks, so I need an answer from you this week.

subject: Re: Multi-year renewal - pricing
body: Following up on Thursday. Any thoughts on the 20%? I have a procurement sync at 4 PM today and would like to bring something back.

subject: Winding down our account
body: Thanks for the work over the past year. We have decided not to renew in November. Nothing dramatic, the reporting never quite fit how our plants track batches, and we ended up rebuilding most of it in spreadsheets anyway. Happy to do a call if useful, otherwise I will let our finance team know to stop the auto-renewal.

subject: Sprint 34 update + one risk
body: Sprint 34 closes Wednesday. Supplier import is done, the emissions factor update is at 80%. One risk: the export service has been timing out on large accounts since Friday and we have not found the cause yet. Nothing needed from anyone outside the team right now, I will update on Wednesday.

subject: Payroll approval needed by Tue 5 PM ET
body: September payroll is ready for your approval. Two changes since August: Jae-won moved to the higher contractor rate you approved, and we added the new data engineer as pending. If I do not have your approval in the portal by Tuesday 5 PM ET, the run slips to the following cycle and everyone is paid five days late.

subject: Action required: verify your wire recipients within 24 hours
body: We detected unusual activity on your business account. To keep outgoing transfers active, confirm your recipient list using the secure link below within 24 hours. Failure to verify will result in temporary suspension of outgoing wires. Do not reply to this message, use the verification portal.

subject: Updated bank details for invoice 2214
body: Hi Sam, our bank has changed as part of a group restructure. Please use the updated account details in the attached PDF for invoice 2214 which is due this week. Kindly confirm once the payment has been actioned so we can update our records.

subject: Brightfield MSA redlines - two open points
body: Their counsel sent redlines. Most is standard. Two points need your decision: they want uncapped liability for data breaches, and a 12-month exclusivity clause for the dairy segment. My recommendation is to reject both, but exclusivity is a commercial call, not a legal one. Marked up copy attached.

subject: Recording invite: 45 minutes, week of Sept 21
body: We cover climate software for operators, about 11k listeners per episode. I would love to have you on to talk about measuring scope 3 emissions in food supply chains. We record remotely, 45 minutes, and we are booking the week of Sept 21. Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works best on our side.

subject: Speaker confirmation deadline: today 6 PM ET
body: You are listed as a confirmed panelist for Supply Chain Data That Actually Gets Used on Oct 8 in Chicago. We go to print with the program today. Confirm your participation by 6 PM ET or we will fill the seat from the waitlist. Travel is not covered, the hotel block closes tonight.

subject: Offer - competing timeline
body: Thank you for the offer, I am genuinely excited about the emissions factor work. I have a second offer with a deadline of Wednesday. Verdano is my preference, but the base is 12k lower and there is no equity refresh mentioned. If you can move on either, I will sign this week.

subject: Northwater churn - what I know
body: I saw Marcus copied you on the non-renewal. Context: their plant managers asked for batch-level reporting in March and we told them Q4. Usage dropped from 40 sessions a week to 6 after June. I flagged it in the July account review. I can try a save call, but I do not think we get them back without batch reporting.

subject: Invoice 2209 - charged twice?
body: I see two charges of $398 on Sept 3 and Sept 9 for what looks like the same invoice. Screenshot from our bank attached. Can someone check and refund if it is a duplicate? Not urgent, but our accountant flagged it.

subject: Security disclosure: exposed API key in your public repo
body: I found a live API key for your reporting service committed in a public repository under your org, file config/settings_sample.py, pushed 11 days ago. The key still works, I did not use it beyond one read request to confirm. I am not asking for a bounty. Rotate it and check your access logs. I can send details to whoever handles this.

subject: Website copy: I need your one-liner
body: The new homepage is ready except the hero line. I have three options from the old deck but none of them sound like you. Can you give me one sentence on what Verdano does, in your own words? I need it by Wednesday to hit the launch date.

subject: Intros to two LPs ahead of your A
body: Priya asked me to line up two intros for you: one fund that leads climate infrastructure at Series A, and one strategic investor from a food manufacturing group. Both said yes to a warm intro. I need a two-paragraph blurb and your latest metrics one-pager to send along. Can you get me both this week?

subject: Can we talk this week?
body: Got a few minutes this week? Something I would rather say on a call than in email. Not urgent, but sooner is better than later.

subject: Field trip consent form due Wednesday
body: A reminder that the consent form and the $35 fee for the Hudson Valley farm trip are due Wednesday. Students without a signed form stay at school that day. The form can be returned by email or in the office.

body: Flight AT414 from Newark to Chicago on Sept 23 has been rescheduled from 7:05 AM to 11:40 AM. Your connection is unaffected. You can accept the change, rebook without a fee within 24 hours, or request a refund.

subject: Appointment reminder: Sept 17, 3:00 PM
body: This is a reminder of your cleaning on Thursday Sept 17 at 3:00 PM. Reply CONFIRM to keep the slot. Cancellations within 24 hours are charged at 50%.

subject: Quick: are you free Wed 2 PM?
body: I have a 30 minute gap Wednesday at 2 PM ET and would like to use it for the pre board walkthrough. Works on my side, and I can do it from the car if you are fine with audio only.

subject: QBR Wednesday 2 PM?
body: Our quarterly review is overdue. I can bring the plant leads on Wednesday at 2 PM ET, we would need a full hour. If Wednesday does not work, the next time I can get all four of them in one room is Oct 6.

subject: Comment by 3 PM today on the CSRD reporting changes
body: I am writing about the CSRD amendment and how it lands for mid-size food manufacturers. I want one or two quotes from a software vendor working with them. Deadline is 3 PM ET today. Two questions: does the amendment reduce the reporting burden in practice, and what are your customers actually doing about scope 3.

subject: Demo request - 40 SKUs, 6 co-manufacturers
body: We make 40 SKUs across six co-manufacturers and our retailer is asking for supplier level emissions data by January. Saw your case study with a bakery group. Can we see a demo in the next two weeks? I am in Austin, and our ops lead would join.

subject: Do you support EU suppliers?
body: Quick question before we book anything: do you support suppliers based in the EU, and do you hold data in the EU? We are in Hamburg and our legal team will ask both questions before a demo.

subject: Final notice: your trial ends in 48 hours
body: Your Deskline trial ends in 48 hours. Upgrade now to keep your ticket history, saved views and macros. After the trial your workspace is archived for 30 days and then deleted. Plans start at $29 per agent.

subject: Cut your cloud spend 40% - 15 minutes?
body: We help Series A startups cut cloud spend by an average of 40% with no code changes. We only get paid from what we save. Do you have 15 minutes Thursday or Friday to see if there is anything here for Verdano?

subject: 500 vetted engineers, ready in 72 hours
body: Our bench has 500 pre vetted engineers across data, backend and mobile, available within 72 hours at $28 per hour. Attached are five profiles that match your open data engineer role. Happy to run a trial week at no cost.

subject: The scope 3 reckoning nobody budgeted for
body: This week: three food groups quietly moved their supplier data deadlines, the EU amendment explained in plain language, and why primary data collection is still mostly manual. Plus five funding rounds in climate accounting software.

subject: Net revenue retention benchmarks, Q3 2026
body: Median NRR for seed stage B2B software dropped to 101% this quarter. In this issue: the expansion levers that still work, why logo churn is a lagging indicator, and a spreadsheet template for cohort analysis.

subject: You are not behind
body: A short letter this week about comparison and pacing, plus an exercise for founders who cannot switch off on weekends. Reply to this email if you want the workbook.

subject: 3 new applicants for Data Engineer
body: Three candidates applied to Data Engineer since Friday. Two have completed the screening questions. No action is required in the system, applications stay in the pipeline until someone reviews them.

subject: Your payout of $18,420.00 is on the way
body: A payout of $18,420.00 has been initiated to your account ending 4471 and should arrive within two business days. This covers customer payments settled between Sept 5 and Sept 12.

subject: Your workspace is 92% full

body: Renata invited you to All hands, Wednesday 10:00 to 10:30 AM ET, recurring weekly. Agenda in the linked doc: September numbers, the export incident, and one customer story.

subject: Need your approval: infra plan upgrade, $1,100 per month
body: The export timeouts are partly a capacity problem. Moving to the next Corestack tier costs $1,100 a month on top of what we pay now and would fix the large account exports this week. The alternative is two weeks of optimization work by Tomek, which I would rather spend on the emissions factor release. Your call, but I need it today to get it in before the sprint closes.

subject: Report export failing since Friday
body: Every export over about 5,000 rows times out and returns an error. It started Friday morning. I need the September supplier report for a board pack on Wednesday, and right now I cannot get the data out at all. Screenshot of the error attached. Dana knows I am chasing this.

subject: Reseller partnership for our food manufacturing clients?
body: We advise 30 mid-size food manufacturers on compliance and most of them are about to be asked for supplier emissions data. We would like to resell or refer Verdano and take a margin. Is there an existing partner program, and if not, would you build one with us as the first partner?

body: Someone nominated Verdano for this year's Climate 50, a list of climate software companies to watch. To be considered you need to submit the company form by Sept 25: funding, headcount, customers served and one measurable outcome. There is no fee.

I need the signed application and the updated board list back before then, otherwise the policy lapses and you are uninsured until a new one is bound, which takes about two weeks. The premium is unchanged at $6,800 for the year. Application attached, two signature fields.

subject: I have three data engineers ready to interview
body: I place data engineers at climate startups and I have three candidates who just came off the market. My fee is 18% with a 90 day guarantee. Can I send profiles over? I can have them in your calendar this week.

body: The Q3 estimated payment is due tomorrow, Sept 15. The voucher and the calculated amount of $4,120 are attached. If the payment is late the penalty accrues daily. Confirm once it is scheduled and we will note it in the file.

body: I introduced you to Ana Duarte at Vessel Foods three weeks ago, she runs sustainability for 11 plants and was ready to pilot. She asked me on Friday whether Verdano was still interested. Awkward for me. Did the thread get lost?

subject: Thank you
body: Just wanted to say the new supplier view saved our production manager about a day of work last month. She told me to tell you. No reply needed.
